summary: Completed one bounded offline discovery pass for CASE-17. Orion Analytics is a separate telemetry pipeline owned by Rina Patel and does not process reviewer case IDs. CASE-17 belongs to Orion Review Gateway; Avery Cole is its documented lead and the available engineering-ownership signal. Approved ADR-042 requires a retry to preserve the existing case and return it to manual review, with no automatic approval. Implementation remains unready until the Gateway interface/authorization/acknowledgement contract, retry recovery semantics, existing UI guidance, and real integration test route are confirmed. Teams was unavailable and no real account, network, callback, implementation, or runtime verification occurred.
